themes.title: Roommate noise and feeling dismissed
themes.interpretation: The student describes a late-night noise problem and may have felt brushed off when they raised it.

evidence.quote: My roommates stay up until three in the morning and I cannot study.
They said I am too sensitive

themes.title: Feeling like an outsider at home
themes.interpretation: The student may feel left out in their own living space, and may be staying quiet to avoid more friction.

evidence.quote: I feel like an outsider in my own home.
Nobody asks me to join dinner.

themes.title: Rent is more than planned
themes.interpretation: The student seems to be under weekly money pressure, with a lease that is hard to leave without losing money.

evidence.quote: the rent is more than I planned
My scholarship covers tuition but not rent

recommendations.topic: Explore what is making home feel hard
recommendations.open_question: What would a good evening at home look like for you?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Make room for how it feels to be left out, then look at options for the noise together.
based_on_titles: Feeling like an outsider at home

recommendations.topic: Look at the rent pressure together
recommendations.open_question: What would make the rent feel more manageable for you?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Talk through the options, and point to financial aid or housing support, including how to ask for help.
